description: a shop: one chart, order, whose actors pay through an invoked service of type payment that never answers

charts.name: order.scxml
charts.text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="order" initial="paying">
  <datamodel><data id="amount" expr="_event.data ? _event.data.amount : 0"/><data id="tries" expr="0"/></datamodel>
  <state id="paying">
    <onentry><log label="order" expr="'paying v1'"/></onentry>
    <invoke id="pay" type="payment" src="payments:charge"><param name="amount" expr="amount"/></invoke>
    <transition event="payment.ok" target="paid"/>
    <transition event="ping"><assign location="tries" expr="tries + 1"/></transition>
    <transition event="question"><send targetexpr="_event.origin" event="answer"><param name="tries" expr="tries"/></send></transition>
  </state>
  <state id="paid"/>
</scxml>
